title: RenderRecord
description: Document written beside a render directory's plane files, last.

adapter.description: Adapter the frames were drawn on; absent in renders written before it was recorded.

chunks.description: One entry per film second that holds a tick, ascending.

film.description: Film the render was made from.

ticks.description: One entry per whole-tick frame, in strictly ascending film-clock order.

AdapterClass.description: What kind of adapter drew a render.

oneOf.description: A GPU: any adapter that is not a CPU implementation.
A CPU implementation, such as lavapipe or WARP.

CameraPose.description: Camera pose the frame was drawn from.

fov_degrees.description: Vertical field of view in degrees.

roll_radians.description: View roll about the forward axis in radians.

FilmId.description:
Identity of the film an artifact was produced from: the bytes of its `.FLM` and archive.

Every field is optional because older captures and renders may lack it; two identities
conflict on a field only when both carry it.

all_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the `.ALL` as made, so a later `make-all` cannot hide which one was played.
A capture records the unstubbed archive, not the sound-stubbed copy it plays (ADR 0043).

name.description: File name of the `.FLM`, without a directory.

viewport_rows.description: Rows the 3D scene was drawn into when the render narrowed its viewport.

RenderAdapter.description: The graphics adapter a render was drawn on.

class.description: Whether the adapter is a GPU or a CPU implementation.

name.description: Adapter name as its driver reports it.

RenderChunk.description: One film second of a render: an independent zstd frame in each plane file.

second.description: Film second the chunk holds: the ticks with `tick / RENDER_CHUNK_TICKS == second`.

ticks.description: Ticks in the chunk, consecutive in the record and in film-clock order.

RenderPalette.description: Film palette controls the frame at a tick was drawn with.

sky.description: Film variable 13, the palette's night term.

RenderTick.description: One rendered tick: its film clock, how it was drawn, and which stored palette it shows.

camera.description: Camera the frame was drawn from.

credits.description:
The film shows credits at this tick, as `PLAYONE` draws them. Parity masks the
cursor's palette index only when this is false, whatever the render drew.

palette.description: Controls the frame was drawn with.

palette_index.description:
Index into `palettes.zst` of the colours the frame shows: its picture is
`palette[index]` for every pixel.

tick.description: Film clock of the frame (0-based 50 Hz tick).

StoreSpan.description: A byte range of one of a render's plane files.

length.description: Compressed length of the chunk in bytes.

offset.description: First byte of the chunk in the file.
